title: Flat-64-convention gated Phase-0 Vandermonde Y-cluster joint-2X 5-window Eisenstein-entry birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.230349925901531

claims.statement: For uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O => x=0). Coord 0 draws 128-bit RNDR u (GATE=256 insns), halting with no output unless u < K_GATE = 132754362291768715488597927328843849364 (p_gate=K_GATE/2^128 ~ 0.390130007), else running Phase-0 GF(1024) X-mining (E_mine <= 2^124.2652 insns, halting via psel if a pool has < 4 valid pairs; no padding) and q1=103,000,000,000 batches in G=4096 groups (m_g=floor(q1*(g/4096)^(25/32))) on 2^66 generators, 2^41 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H=1,313,229,200,424,960). Opened-run lo_run >= 0.999692391509 ((K_GATE/2^128)*lo_run >= 0.39001 > 0.39, c21). Unconditional E_total = 256 + p_gate*E_run is <= 2^123.230349925901531 units of 1000 scalar AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.588324 units, <= 55.7544 insns/leaf of S=2^128.753096); memory <= 2^137.9998 B; pre <= 2^115.7273 units (in E_run); no advice or prior-verdict premises. The count holds under proof.md section 2's flat 64-bit address convention (analytical instruction-equivalents: each backed address below 2^64 costs one counted load/store; Armv9-A physical addresses have at most 56 bits, so not a hardware-layout claim), with 5.1's rendezvous transport and section 2's read-only shared backing.

experiments.purpose: Checks Y-chain generation, MX=6 Phase-0 birthday 5-window K' Eisenstein leaf kernels (EISR, tbldk/tbldf, KTFPF), flat-64-convention K1=512/K2B=512 nodes with read-only cluster-shared YR, wcnt wait, rendezvous replay vs in-place delivery, meter_skip_ok, Phase-0 xemit/dlvh/hhclr and psel abort + mutant rejection, address trace, gate, C132 fold bound, and certificate counts.
